title: form_draft.js browser choreography has zero coverage; the bug-hunt E2E scenario its test header cites does not exist
detail: The save-trigger listener, saveNow fetch flow (closed-vacancy latch, payload dedupe), pagehide beacon, continue-button flow and prep-note swap are untested at any level; no save-and-resume scenario exists under .claude/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/ (grep for draft-continue/form_draft/continue-link returns nothing). Deleting the rt:form-step-changed listener would silently kill all draft saving with every test green — server integration tests hit the endpoints directly.
recommended_fix: Add the cited bug-hunt scenario (start form → change step → draft row → resume pre-filled → submit stripped), and/or factor saveNow/beacon into injectable factories like apply_analytics.js's createCapture for node tests.

title: form.js form-resume anti-clobber guard — a named round-1 regression fix — has no test pin
detail: The server half (backdated _form_loaded_at render) is pinned by resume_page_backdates_the_timing_field_test, but this client guard is untested — form.js has no test file. Reverting the guard re-opens the named black-hole regression with all tests green.
recommended_fix: Add a node test stubbing document.body with data-apply-page=form-resume before requiring form.js, asserting the pre-set _form_loaded_at value survives.

title: apply_analytics.js rt:draft-saved relay and form-resume funnel suppression unpinned at wiring level
detail: Only the outcomeEvent mapping and event-name constants are pinned; the relay listener and the claimed funnel suppression on form-resume (early return before funnel wiring) have no wiring-level test. Metrics-only, and untested wiring matches this file's pre-existing norm — hence note.
recommended_fix: No change required to ship; if hardening, extract the marker→wiring decision into an exported pure function (as done for createAbandonFlow) and pin form-resume suppressing section events.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: draft round-trip, token auth/uniform 404, cooldown claim/clear, strip-on-submit, resume-once semantics, expiry sweep (closed/past-closes_at/archived), erasure confirm-delete, vacancy cascade, and the no-files/no-consent field filter are all integration- or unit-pinned. P1 ~85%: every server surface pinned, but form_draft.js wiring, the form.js resume guard, and the analytics draft-saved relay have no coverage. Overall ≥80%.
recommended_fix: Ship the missing bug-hunt save-and-resume E2E scenario plus small node-level pins for the form.js guard and draft-saved relay to lift P1 coverage to ≥90% (PASS).
